bibl.title: Letters of A.S. Hunt and O. Gradenwitz, 1900-1933.
bibl.seg: 160 Bell Harold Idris Gradenwitz Otto Hunt Arthur Surridge Waddell William Gillan
Nikolaos Gonis & Susan Fogarty, Letters of A.S. Hunt and O. Gradenwitz, 1900-1933.
bibl.note: Annotated edition of the extant correspondence of A.S. Hunt and O. Gradenwitz and related items: fourteen letters and postcards written by Hunt to O. Gradenwitz; one letter of Gradenwitz to Hunt; one postcard sent by Gradenwitz to H.I. Bell; and a letter of W.G. Waddell to Bell.
